title: Call of Duty: Warzone Season 05 Patch Notes

facts.text: Season 05 official Warzone patch notes were published July 22, 2026 by Raven Software.
Raven described AR and SMG weapon choice as broadly healthy and said Season 05 makes targeted adjustments intended to open the meta rather than establish one official best weapon.
FG42 was added as a new Assault Rifle in Season 05.
AK-27 was nerfed: maximum damage 39→38, maximum-damage range 40m→36m, medium damage 35→32 with that range ending at 52m, and BR/Resurgence bullet velocity 920→900 m/s.
AN-94 minimum damage beyond 60m increased from 30 to 32 in the Season 05 Warzone tuning.
Carbon 57 was nerfed at close/medium range: maximum damage 35→34, maximum range 13.8m→12.4m, medium damage 31→30, and headshot multiplier 1.20x→1.13x.
Sturmwolf 45 received close/medium damage buffs: maximum damage 45→47 and medium damage 41→42.
VST medium-damage range was extended to 22.5m.
Swordfish A1 burst-fire delay increased from 280ms to 300ms; its MFS Penta Burst Mod also received more recoil and a smaller burst-delay improvement.
Verdansk received the Drone Labs POI in Season 05.
